marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind northeast 20 knots increasing to northwest 30 late this
morning then diminishing to west 20 late this evening. Wind diminishing to west
10 to 15 late overnight. Wind west 10 to 15 Thursday. Rain changing to snow early this afternoon then to flurries
this afternoon and ending this evening. Showers Thursday. Fog banks dissipating
near noon. <br/>

marine.text:
Wind northeast 15 knots increasing to northwest 30 this morning
then diminishing to west 20 this evening. Wind diminishing to west 10 to 15
after midnight then becoming light early Thursday morning. Wind becoming
northwest 10 to 15 near noon Thursday then diminishing to light Thursday
evening. Rain ending this afternoon. Showers Thursday morning. Fog
patches dissipating this morning. <br/>
